name: Black Swan Pub, Hotel & Restaurant
description: This casual 17th-century stone pub with rooms is 2 miles from the market town of Masham.

name: The Green Dragon
description: Located in the charming Yorkshire village of Hardraw. The Green Dragon Inn stands in a stunning location overlooking Upper Wensleydale. Situated beneath the rising fells of Great Shunner Fell, not far from the town of Hawes.

name: Premier Inn Skipton North (Gargrave) hotel
description: Watch the world drift by at Premier Inn Hotel Skipton North (Gargrave), right next to the scenic Leeds to Liverpool canal in the quiet village of Gargrave.
